subject: Request: Hosted API pen-test report + proposed secure reviewer access
messages:
From: Lydia Park <security@acme-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@acme-cloud.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API) and sharing options

Hi Ben,

Our InfoSec team is doing a routine SIG/SOC2 review and they asked for the latest penetration test for Redwood's hosted API stack (public endpoints, control plane, and auth flows). We need a copy of the full report and a short executive summary. Two asks from our side:

- Can you confirm that the scope includes production public API endpoints and the admin console?
- How do you prefer to share the artifacts securely (we prefer not to receive plaintext email attachments)? Options we'd accept: SFTP, one-time presigned S3 link with short expiry, or a secure portal with enforced MFA.

Also note we will need a redacted version for a cross-functional review (PII removed). If you have a reviewer access flow (time-limited access for 1-3 reviewers) that would be ideal. Can you propose an approach and estimated delivery timeline?

Thanks,
Lydia
Lydia Park
Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <security@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API) and sharing options

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, our latest test covered production public API endpoints and admin console auth flows; we can provide both the full encrypted package and a pre-redacted executive summary.

Proposed sharing options (pick one):

1) Encrypted ZIP delivered to your SFTP server (preferred for longer retention). We will upload redwood-pt-full-encrypted-20261101.zip and provide an HMAC-signed filename + SHA256 checksum.
2) Short-lived presigned S3 link (48 hours) to the encrypted bundle and a separate short link to the summary PDF. We will send the presigned URL and then deliver the decryption passphrase via a separate channel (SMS or a different email thread).
3) Time-limited reviewer access to our secure evidence portal (requires SAML or invites; reviewers get 72-hour access and we can limit downloads).

For redaction: we can provide a pre-redacted executive summary (PDF) and a redaction guide that lists what we removed (client IDs, ephemeral keys, customer-specific IPs). If you need more granular redaction, we can do an additional pass but that adds ~2 business days.

Next steps: confirm which transfer option you prefer and how many reviewers need access. After that I'll loop in Marissa (security ops) and Grace (legal/compliance) to action the transfer.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 11:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme Cloud request — decision on transfer method?

Marissa / Grace — Acme asked for the report and a reviewer-access flow. Lydia's preferred channels are SFTP, presigned S3, or our portal. They need the summary + full encrypted package; redaction requested for cross-functional review.

Can you advise fastest secure option that meets their constraints? If portal, what onboarding ETA for 2 reviewers (likely one security analyst + one compliance reviewer)? If presigned S3, I assume we can do 48h expiry and deliver passphrase via Authy/email-to-phone.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <security@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Acme Cloud request — decision on transfer method?

Ben — short response from SecOps: all three options are supported. Recommended order by compliance/least manual work:

1) Evidence portal (fastest for reviewer access controls). We can invite reviewers by email, require MFA, and set a 72-hour expiration and disable downloads if requested. We will also capture auditor access logs. Onboarding ETA: ~24 hours if they already have SAML/SSO; ~48 hours for invite + manual verification.

2) Presigned S3 link to encrypted ZIP (48h expiry). We'll upload redwood-pt-full-encrypted-20261101.zip to a restricted bucket and send the URL in a separate outbound. Passphrase must be delivered out-of-band (we prefer phone/SMS or a separate email thread marked "passphrase only").

3) SFTP upload to customer endpoint if they provide host + creds. That requires coordination but is doable same-day if creds provided.

Redaction: SecOps can produce a pre-redacted executive summary (attached) and a redaction manifest listing fields removed. Full unredacted package will remain encrypted until we confirm recipient acceptance and an NDA record.

I'll prepare the portal invites and the pre-redacted summary (attached). Ben — do you want me to proceed with the portal invite or the presigned S3?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pt-summary-20261101.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <security@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Delivery plan and timeline for PT package — Acme Cloud

Hi Lydia — following SecOps recommendations, we propose the evidence portal workflow to give your reviewers the best balance of security and auditability. Plan below: 

- Portal invites for two reviewers (security@acme-cloud.com and compliance@acme-cloud.com). Invites sent within 24 hours. Reviewers will be required to complete MFA and will have 72-hour access.
- We will attach the pre-redacted executive summary directly to the portal invite (redwood-pt-summary-20261101.pdf).
- For the full report, we will upload an encrypted bundle (redwood-pt-full-encrypted-20261101.zip) to the portal but keep downloads disabled by default. If you need the full encrypted package for your internal archive, we will enable a one-time download and provide the decryption passphrase via SMS to the reviewer contact.

If you prefer presigned S3 instead, we can do that immediately (48h expiry) and send passphrase via SMS. Please confirm which path you prefer by EOD today and provide the reviewer email addresses you want invited.

Ben

From: Lydia Park <security@acme-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Delivery plan and timeline for PT package — Acme Cloud

Ben — portal flow sounds perfect. Please invite the following reviewers: security@acme-cloud.com and compliance@acme-cloud.com. We will accept MFA and will request a one-time download of the encrypted package (if necessary) after internal signoff. Please proceed with portal invites and attach the pre-redacted summary.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Lydia Park
Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud
